title_hi: एक भोर से एक साँझ तक
summary: The river at sunrise, the temple, the lanes, and the lamps at night.

plan.theme: The river, the temple, the lanes

stops.title: Subah-e-Banaras at Assi Ghat
stops.note: Morning aarti, ragas and yoga as the sun rises over the far bank.

stops.title: Boat from Assi to Dashashwamedh
stops.note: An hour on the water past most of the main ghats, including Manikarnika.

stops.title: Kashi Vishwanath darshan
stops.note: Enter through the corridor from Lalita Ghat.

stops.title: Kachori-sabzi breakfast
stops.note: Kachori Gali is a short walk from the temple.

stops.title: Walk the galis
stops.note: Vishwanath Gali, Thatheri Bazaar and the brass and silk lanes toward Chowk.

stops.title: Rest at the ghats
stops.note: Tea on the steps as the light softens.

stops.title: Ganga Aarti
stops.note: Arrive early for a place on the steps or a boat.

summary: Day one on the river; day two where the Buddha first taught, and the south of the city.

plan.theme: The river, the temple, the lanes

stops.title: Subah-e-Banaras at Assi Ghat
stops.note: Morning aarti as the sun rises.

stops.title: Boat to Dashashwamedh
stops.note: Past the ghats, including Manikarnika.

stops.title: Kashi Vishwanath darshan
stops.note: Through the corridor.

stops.title: Breakfast and the galis
stops.note: Kachori-sabzi, then Thatheri Bazaar and Chowk.

stops.title: Ganga Aarti
stops.note: From the steps or a boat.

stops.title: Sarnath
stops.note: Dhamek Stupa, the excavated monasteries, Mulagandha Kuti Vihar and the museum with the Ashokan lion capital.

stops.title: Lunch back in the city
stops.note: Lanka or Assi.

stops.title: BHU campus and the New Vishwanath Temple
stops.note: Wide avenues, the Bharat Kala Bhavan museum.

stops.title: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
stops.note: Tuesday and Saturday evenings are the busiest.

stops.title: Durga Kund Temple
stops.note: The red temple by its tank, lit for the evening.

summary: Two days as above, then a third across the city's Buddhist, Jain, Bhakti, Sikh, Islamic and Christian sites, ending at Namo Ghat.
